name: comp-326
blurb: Modal for account login with email, password, and remember-me option.
description: A shadcn Dialog with email and password fields, a remember-me checkbox, forgot-password link, and Google login option.
use_when: Authenticating returning users with a lightweight, non-navigating sign-in flow embedded in the page.
avoid_when: When you need robust credential validation or multi-factor authentication — the form is intentionally minimal.
a11y: Form fields have unique IDs with associated labels; password is type=password; checkbox is properly labeled; full keyboard support.
